# Westlaw State Government Resources

> > Comprehensive free legal research platform providing access to state court cases, statutes, regulations, rules, and attorney general opinions across all U.S. states.

Westlaw's government portal aggregates official state legal materials including case law, legislative records, court procedures, and regulatory codes. The platform leverages natural language search capabilities to enable legal professionals and the public to access authoritative state government legal resources.

## Key Topics

- State Court Cases
- Court Rules
- Statutes and Regulations
- Attorney General Opinions
- Case Law Search
- Legal Research
- Civil Procedure
- Jury Instructions
- Official Reports
- Legislative Session Laws
- Free Legal Access
- Supreme Court Opinions
- Administrative Law
- Natural Language Search
- Thomson Reuters

## Core Resources

- [State Government Sites](https://govt.westlaw.com/Home/Index.html): Homepage and main entry point for Westlaw state government resources
- [State Government Sites Directory](https://govt.westlaw.com/SiteList): Directory listing of state government legal resources across all states

## State Case Law & Court Reports

- [Alaska Case Law Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/akcases/Index): Alaska Supreme Court and Appeals case law database with searchable opinions
- [California Public Law Library Briefs Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/cabriefs/Index): California Supreme Court and Appeals court briefs searchable database
- [Michigan Official Reports](https://govt.westlaw.com/miofficial/Index): Michigan Supreme Court and Appeals court official reports database
- [New York Official Reports Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/nyofficial/Index): New York Court of Appeals and Appellate Division official reports
- [Clarence Darrow Cases](https://govt.westlaw.com/clar/Index): Searchable database of historic Clarence Darrow case law

## State Court Rules & Procedures

- [Arizona Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/azrules/Index): Arizona court rules, civil procedure, and evidence rules reference
- [Kentucky Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/kyrules/Index): Kentucky court rules, civil/criminal procedure, and evidence rules
- [Maryland Code and Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/mdc/Index): Maryland code, court rules, and constitutional reference materials
- [Arkansas Model Jury Instructions - Civil](https://govt.westlaw.com/armji/Index): Arkansas civil model jury instructions for negligence and tort cases

## State Statutes & Regulations

- [California Code of Regulations](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Index): California regulatory code and administrative law reference database
- [Official Oklahoma Statutes (Unannotated)](https://govt.westlaw.com/okjc/Index): Oklahoma unannotated statutes and statutory codes reference
- [Official Oklahoma Session Laws](https://govt.westlaw.com/okleg/Index): Oklahoma official session laws legislative records database
- [Oklahoma Historical Statutes (Unannotated)](https://govt.westlaw.com/okhs/Index): Oklahoma historical unannotated statutes and constitutional reference
- [Oklahoma Historical Session Laws](https://govt.westlaw.com/okhl/Index): Oklahoma historical session laws with natural language search
- [New York State Register](https://govt.westlaw.com/nyreg/Index): New York State Register for rule-making and government notices

## Attorney General Opinions

- [Iowa Department of Justice Attorney General Opinions](https://govt.westlaw.com/iaag/Index): Iowa Attorney General opinions searchable archive
- [Mississippi Attorney General Opinions](https://govt.westlaw.com/msag/Index): Mississippi Attorney General searchable opinions database
